name: Pig and Whistle Tavern
summary: In Stormwind City's Old Town, the Pig and Whistle Tavern draws travelers and local laborers. Veterans gather there to recall the kingdom's past conflicts.

sections.title: A Refuge in Old Town
sections.body: In Old Town's winding alleys, the Pig and Whistle Tavern gives citizens, workers, and road-weary travelers a place to find warmth, ale, and lodging. Recipe vendor Kendor Kabonka shares the room with grizzled veterans. Over their tankards, they remember the First and Second Wars.

faq.q: Where is the Pig and Whistle Tavern located?
faq.answer: The Pig and Whistle Tavern stands in Old Town, Stormwind City's eastern district, among military barracks, rogue dens, and working-class quarters.

aliases: who is in pig and whistle
faq.answer: Travelers, off-duty guards, and veteran soldiers frequent the tavern. The veterans trade stories of the First and Second Wars, and merchant Kendor Kabonka sells cooking recipes there.

faq.q: What services does the tavern provide?
aliases: is pig and whistle an inn
faq.answer: Weary travelers can rest at the Pig and Whistle Tavern and buy food, drink, and specialized cooking recipes.

angles.text: Cooks can find Kendor Kabonka at the tavern. He sells rare cooking recipes from across Azeroth.
For Alliance soldiers and travelers passing through the capital, the tavern offers a welcoming hearth and the company of veterans from the realm's earlier wars.
